name: integrations
title: Integrations
description: Tabbed integrations showcase with copy, CTA and framed screenshot per tab. Uses /geneva/wallet.jpg, send-1.jpg, transactions.jpg and documents-grid.jpg.

import Link from "next/link" import { ChevronRightIcon } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs" import { ScreenFrame } from "@/components/geneva/screen-frame" import { SectionHeading } from "@/components/geneva/section-heading" const integrations = [ { value: "banking", label: "Banking", title: "Connect 12,000+ banks", description: "Securely link your current, savings and credit accounts from banks around the world. Balances and transactions sync automatically, in real time.", image: "/geneva/wallet.jpg", }, { value: "payments", label: "Payments", title: "Send and request money", description: "Pay friends, split bills or request payments with a link. Recipients don't need a Geneva account, and transfers land in seconds.", image: "/geneva/send-1.jpg", }, { value: "accounting", label: "Accounting", title: "Sync with your accounting tools", description: "Push categorised transactions and receipts to your accounting software and close the books in minutes instead of days.", image: "/geneva/transactions.jpg", }, { value: "documents", label: "Documents", title: "Every receipt, filed for you", description: "Upload invoices and receipts or forward them by email. Geneva reads them, matches them to transactions and keeps them searchable.", image: "/geneva/documents-grid.jpg", }, ] export function Integrations({ className }: { className?: string }) { return (
{integrations.map((item) => ( {item.label} ))} {integrations.map((item) => (

{item.title}

{item.description}

))}
) }
